sourceRules.edge: Two merchants are connected iff they share an active link of the same link_type.
sourceRules.activeWindow: The source solution defines an added-on-day-d link of duration t as active for d <= day < d+t.
sourceRules.component: A cluster is a connected component over active links; expiration can split a component, so components are recomputed per day.
sourceRules.pin: Highest degree in the component; tie goes to lexicographically smallest merchant_id.
sourceRules.order: Descending component member count, then pin name ascending.

siteProtocolSupplement.days: Exactly three batches, matching source day1/day2/day3. Batch number supplies the tuple's day field.
siteProtocolSupplement.io: Whitespace-tokenized stdin records and exact three-day textual stdout format are site-added.
siteProtocolSupplement.bounds: At most 200 records total, at most 100 per day, identifiers 1..16 ASCII alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen, duration 0..3.
siteProtocolSupplement.vertices: The source text does not explicitly say whether a merchant with an active but unshared link appears. This candidate follows the standard graph interpretation and explicit site rule: all merchants with an active link are vertices, including singleton components.
siteProtocolSupplement.duplicates: To avoid multiplicity ambiguity, a batch cannot repeat the same (merchant_id, link_type) pair; memberships from separate days are deduplicated while active.
siteProtocolSupplement.format: Each cluster prints size and pin, matching the source's accompanying Python solution format; blank days print only Day X.
siteProtocolSupplement.verification: Passed 152 formal/oracle runs and both normal-exit mutants on the user's own GoJudge server. Production publication remains separate.
